files.content:
# Pixel Tasks

An offline, pixel-styled task list built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No storage, no network, no dependencies.

## Features

- Add tasks by typing text and pressing **Add** or **Enter**.
- Blank or whitespace-only input is ignored.
- Live **Total** and **Remaining** counts (integers, start at 0).
- Check a task to mark it complete; remaining count updates.
- Delete a task to remove it; both counts update.
- Tasks receive increasing numeric IDs (first task: `todo-text-1`, `todo-check-1`, `todo-delete-1`).
- All state lives in memory and resets on reload.

## Controls

| Control | ID |
| --- | --- |
| Task input | `#todo-input` |
| Add button | `#todo-add` |
| Total count | `#todo-total` |
| Remaining count | `#remaining` |
| Task text (nth) | `#todo-text-<n>` |
| Task checkbox (nth) | `#todo-check-<n>` |
| Task delete (nth) | `#todo-delete-<n>` |

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step required.

## Accessibility

- Input and buttons have visible or screen-reader labels.
- Full keyboard support with visible focus rings.
- Counts update in a live region.

## Files

- `index.html` - markup
- `style.css` - pixel theme and responsive layout
- `app.js` - task logic
